subject: Follow-up: HIPAA scoping, BAA availability, and hosting options
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@medibridge.com>, Dr. Alan Ruiz <alan.ruiz@medibridge.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: HIPAA scoping, BAA availability, and hosting options

Hi Emily / Alan —

Great speaking with you earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps so your procurement team has a clear path forward.

Call summary (short):
- Use case: clinical notes ingestion + ontology linking for provider workflow (PHI in payload).
- Volume: estimated 500k requests/month, median prompt length ~300 tokens.
- Key constraints: require BAA, audit logs for access, and explicit controls for PHI retention.

What Redwood can provide today (high level):
- BAA: Yes — we execute a standard BAA for customers handling PHI on Hosted and Dedicated deployments.
- Eligible deployment modes for PHI: Dedicated (reserved GPU pools with tenant isolation) and Private (VPC / on-prem) are acceptable for PHI processing. Hosted (multi-tenant public API) is only acceptable for de-identified data or where customer explicitly confirms no PHI is sent.
- PHI handling boundaries: We treat PHI as transient by default — model inputs are processed in-memory and not persisted beyond request caching windows unless customer opts into storage (e.g., for fine-tuning or logging). Customers can enable customer-managed KMS for encryption keys in Dedicated and Private.

Requested items from your side to move forward:
1) Please confirm whether MediBridge will send PHI in-source (yes/no).
2) Please share your vendor security questionnaire (we attached a fillable version of our standard VSQ to speed things up).
3) If procurement needs to see SOC 2, we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and an executive summary.

Attachments: redwood_vs_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (fillable).

Next steps I propose:
- Emily: share MediBridge VSQ and any procurement timelines.
- Redwood (Neha + Rishi): schedule a 60-min security & architecture deep dive to map data flows and finalize acceptable hosting option.
- Kimberly: circulate SOC 2 redacted copy after confirmation of mutual NDA/procurement request.

Tentative availability for the deep dive: Wed 5/20 10:00–12:00 PT or Thu 5/21 13:00–16:00 PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks again — I’ll queue the VSQ and SOC2 items once you confirm procurement path.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference
From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@medibridge.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dr. Alan Ruiz <alan.ruiz@medibridge.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: HIPAA scoping, BAA availability, and hosting options

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the recap — that aligns with what we discussed. A few quick answers and asks from my side:

- PHI: yes, initial pilot will include PHI (clinical notes and patient identifiers) — we will need BAA and full audit logging.
- VSQ: attaching our procurement checklist and high-level security requirements (MB-Security-Checklist.pdf). Can you confirm whether Hosted can be used if we route and token-scrub before sending? Procurement prefers Dedicated/Private but wants a clear cost delta.
- SOC 2: procurement will need to review SOC 2 Type II. If you can share a redacted copy and an ISSUER/attestation letter, that would be ideal.
- Cloud regions: are Dedicated instances available in us-west-2? Also, do you support GovCloud or isolated FedRAMP-like environments?

We’re aiming to have legal/procurement decisions by end of June; a security deep dive next week would help accelerate.

Attachments: MB-Security-Checklist.pdf (procurement).

Thanks —
Emily Torres
Director, Product Security
MediBridge Health

Emily — thanks for the quick reply and the checklist. Next steps on our side:
1) I’m attaching a redacted SOC 2 Type II (redacted for customer-sensitive items) and our fillable VSQ. Please confirm receipt and which fields you’d like us to pre-populate.
2) Neha will lead the security deep-dive — proposed 60-min meeting: Wed 5/20 10:30–11:30 PT. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda: data flow, hosting recommendation, KMS & logging, and BAA timing.
3) Regarding regions & GovCloud: Dedicated is available in us-west-2. We do not currently offer AWS GovCloud or equivalent FedRAMP enclaves as a fully managed host; Private (on-prem / VPC) can be configured for isolated environments if the customer hosts in GovCloud. I’ll have Neha outline the exact steps.

Attachments included: redwood_soc2_type2_redacted.pdf, redwood_vs_questionnaire_v1.xlsx, hipaa-deployment-matrix.csv

If you’re okay with the 5/20 slot, I’ll send the invite. Also flagging procurement timeline end-of-June — we’ll aim to prioritize SOC2 evidence and a tailored BAA draft.

Best,

Kimberly Park
